title: [Bug] `/usage` command inaccessible despite active subscription
body:
**Bug Description**
Can't see the /usage - claude says only for subscription even though I have one

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: kitty
- Version: 2.0.76
- Feedback ID: 9f4dd016-ebdc-45a2-8e00-b537be95fa9e
author: rureirureirurei

top_comments.author: fgiardina-bm
top_comments.body: I have the Max plan on macOS and the same thing happens.

top_comments.author: silverdolphin863
top_comments.body: can confirm, /usage not displaying even after logout and login, active Max x20 plan, Windows 11. version 2.0.74 (updated to 2.0.76, still same problem).
